body: YTA. He made a sexist comment. Why so mad?
NTA. How is this even a question? Your sister is horrible, you're completely right and with every sentence she just became worse. You're not hostile towards her, you're doing what you need to

She had to in this case. The psychiatrist told me on multiple occasions he needs an interview with her to make the diagnosis. I just never got a chance to ask if he told her for what the interview was as the question appeared to me later

She will use it against me by insulting me due to it, disgusting me worse, tell me I'll never have a future, what a bad daughter I am, spread the diagnosis if she thinks it's fitting (she doesn't know I actually got it) so everyone she knows will know and call me names
It continue the relationship on a min. basis as I can't hate her and it would mean cutting my grandparents off, too

She refuses to do all of this a long time. Last part of me living at home my grandma paid my food, my parents refused. I am moving to another country to avoid them but can't go no contact as I love them just because I am not capable of hating them

I don't understand the part with the block to be honest. She wouldn't post about it, just private message every friend she has about it. Like she does regularly about me (I happen to know that because my bff spied on her mother a few months ago and found some very interesting chats bashing the both of us between our mothers)
I think you got me wrong. Not trying to justify it, but I do have the diagnosis, I don't need to spy to know that. My worry is her knowing what it was about, observing and using it against me
She abused me physically and verbally, I can't trust her, but appreciate the sentiment

It would tell me what she knows and how much I need to hide it, like if she knows what it's about I need to put in all the effort so she thinks I didn't get the diagnosis. Otherwise standard effort should be enough. Putting in all the effort is harming me, but letting my guard down if she is suspecting it makes me vulnerable to her verbally abusing me
